text: In 1971 the infantryman Jacob Singer is [stabbed with a bayonet|trigger|a sudden accident or attack] in Vietnam's Mekong Delta, then wakes on the New York subway in 1975, a postal worker in Brooklyn haunted by visions of his dead son Gabe. [Faceless vibrating figures|images|ghosts and strange figures] crowd the edges of his days, and a psychic tells him he is already dead. Old platoon mates confess the same hallucinations and suspect [a secret military drug|wrong|meddling with life itself], until [suited men warn Jacob off|threat|the powerful and their systems].
